description: Detect the current market regime: BULL (S&P 500 above 200-day MA, VIX below 20), BEAR (below 200-day MA), SIDEWAYS (range-bound), or CRISIS (VIX above 30). Returns regime, confidence percentage, S&P 500 vs 200-day MA, VIX level, and regime duration. Use alongside get_risk_index before trading decisions. Updated every 30 minutes. FREE - no API key required.
name: get_market_regime
